subject: Re: Private Offer — multiregion tier harmonization & reseller split
messages:
From: Mark Jensen <procurement@stellar-hw.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T08:12:00Z
Subject: Private Offer for Stellar — multiregion tiering question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're close to finalizing the internal approval for the private offer but need to align on two items before procurement signs:

1) Multiregion tiering — we operate across EU/UK and need a consistent discount ladder. Can the private offer include a two-band EU tier (0-500k / 500k+) with identical list price in both regions, or do you require per-region list price floors?

2) Reseller/channel split — our reseller (NordicCloud) expects a predictable passback. Can you provide the channel fee percentage and whether it is applied to list price or net after discounts?

I've attached the PO draft (Stellar_PO_Draft_v2.pdf) for reference and included our estimated consumption profile for year 1 on page 2. Our target is signature by the end of next week if these are clarified.

Best,
Mark
Procurement — Stellar Hardware
Attachments: Stellar_PO_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mark Jensen <procurement@stellar-hw.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellar — multiregion tiering question

Hi Mark — thanks for the PO and the profile. Looping in Ben (sales lead for private offers) and Irene (finance / channel ops) so we can lock the structure. Quick answers and items we need from you: 

- Multiregion tiering: We can do a harmonized EU/UK list price if you commit to a single global SKU family for the reserved capacity lines. That keeps billing simple and avoids dual-listing. If you need distinct list prices per legal entity we can do that but it requires separate PO lines (adds reconciliation).

- Channel split: two options we typically offer (pick one):
  A) Fixed passback on list price (recommended for distributors): channel fee = 12% on list price for reserved SKUs, 6% for metered SKUs.
  B) Net-back split: channel receives X% of net revenue after discount (this is unusual for marketplace private offers because of invoicing complexity).

What we need from you to finalize the PO: confirmation of which option you prefer, the legal entity for billing (EU/UK), and approximate monthly consumption cadence (the attached page is helpful but we need month-by-month for billing smoothing).

We'll prepare a revised PO that includes an explicit passback line and list-price floor if you choose option A. Ben/Irene — can you validate the channel percentages below and confirm attachment to the contract template?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Jensen <procurement@stellar-hw.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellar — multiregion tiering question

Vanessa / Irene / Mark — quick note from sales ops:

- Confirming option A as our standard for deals with distributors: 12% channel fee on list price for reserved (dedicated) SKUs, 6% on metered/ephemeral SKUs. Rationale: predictable payout for the reseller and aligns with our marketplace passback flows.

- If Stellar wants the channel fee applied to net instead, that'll require a manual monthly reconciliation and we need to scope that into our finance ops (delays invoice automation).

- On multiregion list price: harmonizing is fine so long as we create a single SKU umbrella and include a geo-clause that protects list price parity (we can add a one-line clause that allows Redwood to adjust list price with 30 days' notice subject to tax/legal review). That keeps NordCloud's margin stable irrespective of minor tax differences.

Forwarding Mark's PO excerpt for visibility:

On Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 08:12 AM Mark Jensen <procurement@stellar-hw.com> wrote:
> "We've attached the PO draft... Our target is signature by the end of next week if these are clarified."

Irene — can you attach the channel margin worksheet (rdw-channel-margin-v1.xlsx) and confirm the invoicing flow (Redwood invoice -> Stellar -> reseller or Redwood invoice -> reseller)? For EU compliance we usually route Redwood invoice to Stellar and issue a separate reseller payout.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Head of Private Offers, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Jensen <procurement@stellar-hw.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Private Offer for Stellar — multiregion tiering question

Thanks all — final operational notes from finance: 

- Channel fee: we'll proceed with option A (12% reserved / 6% metered on list price). This will be a single line item on the PO called "Channel passback" to preserve bookkeeping.

- Invoicing path: Redwood invoices Stellar (primary). Redwood issues a monthly channel remittance to the reseller. We will not split invoices to the reseller directly for EU legal reasons unless a reseller is the contracting party. Please confirm Stellar is contracting entity (and provide VAT id) otherwise we'll need a separate reseller contract.

- List price harmonization: agreeable. We'll include a geo-tier clause: same list price across EU/UK SKUs; any change requires 30 days' notice and notification to Stellar's procurement. 

I've attached the channel margin worksheet for transparency (rdw-channel-margin-v1.xlsx). Mark — if you confirm contracting legal entity and month-by-month consumption we'll push an updated PO and signature-ready DocuSign link today.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Finance & Channel Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachments: rdw-channel-margin-v1.xlsx (Excel, 35KB)
